reconcile.note: Gill reads Jesus's question in Mark 12 as pointing to two natures in one person, David's son by human descent yet David's Lord by a higher divine nature.

sides.snippet: I will raise to David a righteous Branch, and he shall reign as king
sides.verseText: Behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that I will raise to David a righteous Branch, and he shall reign as king and deal wisely, and shall execute justice and righteousness in the land.

sides.snippet: Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son?
sides.verseText: Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son?\" The common people heard him gladly.
